anti_patterns.message: HIGH: Job 'publish' performs deployment without an upstream test job in its 'needs:' chain.
anti_patterns.remediation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

anti_patterns.message: Workflow has build and deploy stages without artifact handoff (upload-artifact / container push).
anti_patterns.remediation: Publish immutable build outputs with actions/upload-artifact or push signed container images before deploying.
